risks.title: Ransomware attack via phishing email
risks.description: Employee clicks malicious attachment; ransomware encrypts file shares and backups.
risks.existing_controls: Email gateway filtering, MalwareBytes on endpoints
risks.mitigation: Implement immutable backups, MFA on all accounts, security awareness training

risks.title: Unauthorized access via exposed RDP
risks.description: RDP port exposed to internet; brute-force or known exploit (BlueKeep) used for initial access.
risks.mitigation: Move RDP behind VPN, enable NLA, enforce account lockout policy

risks.title: GDPR violation — unencrypted PII in transit
risks.description: Customer PII transmitted over HTTP or stored without encryption, risking GDPR Article 32 non-compliance.
risks.mitigation: Enforce TLS 1.2+ on all endpoints, encrypt PII at rest, conduct DPA audit

risks.title: Key person dependency — single sysadmin
risks.description: Critical IT knowledge concentrated in one person; illness or departure causes operational disruption.
risks.mitigation: Cross-train second admin, complete runbook documentation, use password manager

risks.title: Backup failure — NAS storage full
risks.description: NAS reaches capacity; Acronis backup jobs fail silently; data loss on next incident.
risks.mitigation: Automated capacity alerts at 80%, offload to cloud tier, review retention policy

risks.title: Insider threat — excessive user privileges
risks.description: Employees retain admin rights beyond business need; risk of accidental or intentional data exfiltration.
risks.mitigation: Implement least privilege, quarterly access review, enable PAM for admin tasks

risks.title: Third-party vendor breach
risks.description: A key SaaS vendor suffers a breach, exposing organization data or disrupting critical services.
risks.mitigation: Third-party security questionnaire, monitor vendor breach notifications, data minimization

risks.title: Phishing — credential harvesting
risks.description: Employee submits credentials on phishing page; account used for lateral movement or data access.
risks.mitigation: MFA on all accounts, phishing simulation programme, conditional access policies
